title: Ender Chest Palette
description: Dye your Ender Chest in all 16 colors — and each color is its own separate storage
body:
# Ender Chest Palette

Ender Palette lets you dye your Ender Chest in all 16 colors — and each color is its **own
separate storage**. A blue Ender Chest opens your blue inventory, a red one opens your red, and
so on. Every player gets up to **16 private vaults**,
one per color.

It's a small, pure-addition mod: it never changes the vanilla Ender Chest, so it's safe to drop
into any pack and works the same in singleplayer and on servers.

## How it works

- **Dye an Ender Chest any color.** Combine an Ender Chest with a dye to color it (see crafting
  below).
- **Each color is its own storage.** A blue chest only shows what you put in *blue* chests; a red
  chest only shows your *red* contents. That's 16 independent 27-slot inventories per player.
- **Same color, shared everywhere.** Every blue chest you place (or anyone's blue chest you open)
  opens *your* blue storage — just like the vanilla Ender Chest, but per color.
- **Break them freely.** Breaking a chest drops the block back; your stored items live on you, not
  the block, so nothing is ever lost when you pick one up to move it.

## Crafting

| Goal | Recipe (shapeless — any arrangement) |
|------|--------------------------------------|
| Color a chest | **Ender Chest + matching Dye** → that color (e.g. Ender Chest + Blue Dye → Blue Ender Chest) |
| Recolor | **Any colored chest + a different Dye** → the new color |

The recipe accepts the vanilla Ender Chest *or* any colored one, so you can freely recolor like
shulker boxes. (Craft the base Ender Chest the usual way: 8 Obsidian around 1 Eye of Ender.)

## Multiplayer

Built for servers. Storage lives on the server-side player and the chest opens the
vanilla container screen, so it syncs with no extra setup. Each player has their own 16 vaults —
your blue chest and a friend's blue chest are separate. Install the mod on the server and on each client.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft **1.21.11**, **Fabric** (requires Fabric API).
- Does not touch or conflict with the vanilla Ender Chest or other storage mods.

---

Modpacks are welcome — no need to ask. Please don't re-upload or redistribute the mod outside its
official pages.
